# Vendored OpenAPI spec

`rest-api.json` in this folder is a **vendored, point-in-time copy** of the
REST API's `openapi.json`. It is the source that
`content/docs/api/rest/reference/` and `content/docs/api/rest/commands.mdx`
are generated from.

## Why vendored, not fetched

This site is public and statically exported (`next build` / `output:
'export'`). The real `openapi.json` is generated by the API contract package
in a private repository, so it cannot be fetched at build time — a public
build has no credentials to reach it, and shouldn't need any. Vendoring a
committed copy keeps the build hermetic and keeps the private repo entirely
out of this one.

## How to refresh it

You need a local checkout of the API contract package with a freshly
generated `openapi.json`. Then, from this repo:

```bash
node scripts/sync-openapi.mjs /path/to/openapi.json
```

(or `API_CONTRACT_OPENAPI_PATH=/path/to/openapi.json node scripts/sync-openapi.mjs`
if you'd rather set an env var). This:

1. Copies that file to `openapi/rest-api.json`.
2. Updates the "last synced" stamp below.
3. Regenerates `content/docs/api/rest/reference/` and
   `content/docs/api/rest/commands.mdx` (via `scripts/gen-openapi-docs.mjs`).

Review the diff — endpoint pages, the commands catalog, and this stamp should
all move together — then commit it as one change. There's no default path
baked in anywhere in this repo; you always pass one explicitly, so this repo
never has to name the private source.

To regenerate the pages from the *current* vendored copy without a fresh
source file (e.g. after editing this script), run
`node scripts/gen-openapi-docs.mjs` directly.

## What guards against this going stale, and what doesn't

- **Guarded:** `content/docs/api/rest/reference/` and `commands.mdx` are
  generated, never hand-edited. CI regenerates them from
  `openapi/rest-api.json` and fails the build on any diff
  (`gen-openapi-docs` job), the same way `content/docs/reference/functions/`
  is checked against `functions.json`. So the checked-in pages can never
  drift from the checked-in spec.
- **Not guarded:** nothing in this repo or its CI checks whether
  `openapi/rest-api.json` itself still matches the *current* API contract.
  This public repo has no automated way to reach the private source to
  compare against, and deliberately isn't given one. If the private contract
  changes and nobody runs the sync above, this reference will describe an
  older version of the API and nothing will flag it.
- The "vendored on" date and spec version below are the only freshness
  signal available to a reader. Treat this page as informative, not
  load-bearing — if precision matters, ask whoever owns the API contract
  package whether `rest-api.json` here still matches it.
